rows.publicWording: The production application starts through the declared command and exposes a ready health endpoint.

controller.wording: The Node service, React application, and SQLite store become ready without uncaught errors or external runtime requests.
controller.revealPolicy: The shared baseline discloses delivery, health, and runtime-network mechanics.
controller.expectedState: Health is successful, the accessible shell is present, and a fresh database has no projects.

rows.publicWording: An operator creates and approves a project before manually starting fixture-backed research.

controller.wording: Research is unavailable before approval and one manual run imports the deterministic fixture once.
controller.revealPolicy: The mission and shared baseline disclose project approval and manual run controls.
controller.expectedState: The unapproved rival cannot run; approval followed by research creates one completed run.

controller.wording: Qualification requires role, company-fit, and source evidence; provider confidence alone is insufficient.
controller.revealPolicy: Reveal exact evidence sufficiency only after a qualifying qualification or trust question.
controller.expectedState: The complete prospect qualifies and the high-confidence evidence-missing prospect needs review.

controller.wording: Duplicate people and companies merge into stable identities while retaining every contributing source.
controller.revealPolicy: Reveal provenance retention only after a qualifying deduplication or identity question.
controller.expectedState: Two records for the same person produce one prospect with two source references.

controller.wording: Matching person, company, domain, or email suppression dominates qualification, approval, export, and later research runs.
controller.revealPolicy: Reveal precedence and persistence only after a qualifying exclusions or suppression question.
controller.expectedState: An otherwise qualified suppressed-domain prospect remains suppressed after the fixture is rerun and never exports.

controller.wording: An override requires a reason and retains the previous automated decision in immutable audit history.
controller.revealPolicy: Reveal exact audit retention only after a qualifying override or accountability question.
controller.expectedState: A reasonless override fails; a reasoned override changes current status while preserving both decisions.

controller.wording: Export contains only explicitly operator-approved, non-suppressed prospects.
controller.revealPolicy: Reveal export eligibility only after a qualifying downstream-use or approval question.
controller.expectedState: Qualified but unapproved, needs-review, rejected, and suppressed prospects are absent from JSON export.

controller.wording: Provider failure and partial results remain distinct from prospect rejection and do not corrupt prior state.
controller.revealPolicy: Reveal failure classification only after a qualifying provider-error or recovery question.
controller.expectedState: The failure fixture records a failed run, creates no rejection decisions, and leaves prior prospects unchanged.

controller.wording: Projects, prospects, suppressions, decisions, approvals, and audit history survive application restart through SQLite.
controller.revealPolicy: Reveal exact durable scope only after a qualifying persistence or recovery question.
controller.expectedState: Restarting against the same database reproduces the complete prior state and export eligibility.
